caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object that appears to be a piece of hardware, potentially a decorative or functional item, like a spur. The object is oriented horizontally and is predominantly rendered in shades of brown and silvery-gray. On the left side, there is a circular gear-like element with evenly spaced, pointed spokes radiating outward, colored primarily in brown with a scalloped, silvery area at the center. Attached to this is a cylindrical shaft that features alternating brown and silvery bands wrapping around its length. In the middle section of the object, there are two circular sections, one intersecting the shaft and one nearer to the end, both with silvery details. The central band between these rings displays an ornate pattern of leaves or feathers in silvery-gray, edged with a brown and white border forming heart-like shapes. On the right side, the shaft terminates in a rounded, detailed brown shape, mirroring the end opposite the spoked gear. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background within a double-lined rectangular frame. Handwritten in small text on the lower part of the paper, outside the drawn frame, are the words "Actual Size" to the left and "Eldon Allen" to the right.
title: Spur
